jobs.title: Talent Architect
jobs.description_text: King’s Cross, London, with international travel £110,000–£130,000 (flex for the right candidate) Almost every leap in how we live, from medicine to energy to computing, began with a scientific breakthrough. But breakthroughs are getting harder to find and more expensive to make. We think AI can change that. As our Talent Architect, you’ll assemble the team that builds Inherent: focusing on high impact researchers and engineers. You’ll do it with total access to our founding team, and you’ll help invent an AI-native way of doing it. What we’re building Today’s AI is brilliant at giving good answers. It’s far worse at working out which questions are worth asking, and it still can’t learn on the fly. Yet many of the discoveries that changed the world, like penicillin, X-rays and the microwave oven, came from stumbling into unknown unknowns. Inherent exists to build AI that can do that: AI that recursively improves itself to discover new knowledge, working alongside human scientists on the hardest problems we face. Our core bet is that bolting AI onto old ways of working only brings small gains. Electricity didn’t transform industry until factories were redesigned around it, and we think the research lab is no different. So we’re rebuilding ours from scratch. Faraday, our AI scientist, works as a full member of the team. It reads papers, joins meetings, runs experiments, manages compute and even helps with hiring. jobs.description_text: THE ROLE: We are looking for strong engineers with experience and interest in designing, building, and maintaining the novel, high-performance systems that make up our serverless platform. Specifically, you’ll be working on the distributed object storage system that underpins every container image, volume, and checkpoint on Modal: hundreds of petabytes of data, replicated across multiple cloud object stores and a CDN, cached on local NVMe across a large fleet of workers in many datacenters, and shared peer-to-peer within each datacenter. You’ll make cold starts feel local when the data is hundreds of milliseconds away, designing the caching, preloading, and peer-to-peer layers that hide object-store latency and keep public ingress off saturated uplinks. You’ll own durability and cost at petabyte scale, from streaming and batch replication between origins to garbage collection over billions of objects. You’ll work across the stack, from local disk and page cache to distributed blob storage and garbage collection, and you’ll help shape what storage becomes next as we push storage closer to workloads. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON: - Build P2P sharing of data across workers within a single datacenter to dramatically reduce ingress - Replicate data across multiple blob storage providers - Automate garbage collection across hundreds of petabytes of data - Deploy colocated storage clusters to datacenters to accelerate high-throughput customer workloads YOU MAY BE A FIT IF: - You have 5+ year
